items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: My third experience was another in a band in a dancing school in the Bronx, Sylvester Lewis, trumpet player

ctx.x: And that was my second experience. My third experience was another in a band in a dancing school in the Bronx, Sylvester Lewis, trumpet player, and I went up there and that is the last time I was fired off a gig, off that job. The reason I was fired off that one is because I couldn't keep good time. A number would start .... by the time I got to the end I was here .... the bass player and all used to get on me, the trumpet player, everybody. But I just couldn't keep good time.
